suite.description: Spark coding pilot: synthetic behavioral contracts and frozen tool replay; not a full repository-agent benchmark.

messages.content: Implement frames(lines), where lines is a list of decoded SSE lines WITHOUT newline endings. Collect data: fields until a blank line; join their values with newline. Remove at most ONE space following the colon. Ignore comments and other fields. Return payload strings; discard a final event without its blank-line terminator. Return only complete Python code using the standard library.

grader.tests:
assert frames([': ping','data: a','data: b','','data: tail'])==['a\nb']
assert frames(['data:  x','','data:','',''])==[' x','']
assert frames(['event: x',''])==[]
assert frames([])==[]

provenance.source: Original authored contracts and synthetic documents. Reference solutions are excluded from requests.
